about_the_game:
Dodge! Shoot! Fly Further into the Starry Skies

Are you ready? Pilot this ancient fighter aircraft and complete space journeys one after another against an ultra-fast onslaught of enemies! Nimbly dodge enemy attacks, glide past their bullets, and then lock on and fire! Navigate through dangerous starry skies filled with bullets and traps, and show the enemies who truly rules this galaxy!

Combine! Reforge! Discover Your Ultimate Ammunition!

During your flight, you may occasionally collect ammunition dropped by enemies. Combine and reforge to discover bullets that best suit your strategy and gameplay style!

Perhaps you'll find:

  • Taser: Creates lightning chains among enemies!

  • Electromagnetic Cannon: Charges up to release a highly damaging penetrating energy sphere!

  • Medusa's Gaze: Turns low-health enemies directly into meteors!

  • Cold-blooded Killer: dealing 50% extra damage to slowed targets

And over 50 other types of ammunition...

Upgrade! Enhance! Defeat Stronger Enemies!

Upgrade your fighter tailored to your strategy or gameplay style!

Your upgrade options can provide you with:

  • Increased combat power or survival attributes!

  • Build a faction that suits your fighter and ammunition!

  • Immediately restore some lost HP!

  • Make future upgrades easier!

  • Even grant you access to LEGENDARY ammunition that can't be dropped by enemies!

And more abilities await your discovery.

Choose the Super Skill Module!

Different super skill modules will provide your fighter with various base attributes and super skills, including:

  • Slowing down all enemies continuously and causing them damage

  • Converting previously taken damage into increased damage output

  • Shrinking in size and moving faster

And over ten other modules waiting for you to discover!

Gliding past enemy bullets will trigger "Grazing" granting you more energy. Once your energy is full, you can unleash your super skill!

name: Refighter

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT 710, 1 GB or AMD Radeon R7 240, 1 GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Refighter is a lightweight Rogue-like flight shooting and strategy game where players will control spacecraft to engage in battles in space, equipping various bullets and upgrading their levels. Face off against a diverse array of enemies and Bosses.
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Spain, Italian
